name: 23284 · Richmond, VA
findings: ZIP 23284 (Richmond) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (78%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (82% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23284 (Richmond) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
